method: Read official manufacturer/corporate/distributor pages and official search-index excerpts; access status is recorded per source. No supplier contacted; no price/stock/warranty inferred. Text is paraphrased; no full manufacturer document mirrored.

sources.title: ENDO global network
sources.location: Sales Subsidiaries > Vietnam; Headquarters > International Division
observations: Vietnam sales subsidiary and Japan international division are listed.

sources.title: ENDO downloads
observations: Manufacturer product-data search and DIALux partnership are published.

sources.title: ENDO ACCORD55 GSTSA0900WA-WH27
observations: Example: AC220–240V, non-dimmable integrated driver; IES, specification and installation downloads listed. Accessories need separate photometry.

sources.title: ENDO Synca SXS3032S
observations: Example: AC100–242V and SmartLEDZ; IES listed; accessory IES is obtained separately.

sources.title: Panasonic Vietnam lighting products
observations: Vietnam range includes downlights, panels, floods, strips and suspended lighting; DIALux download is linked.

sources.title: Panasonic DIALux plug-in
observations: Official plug-in download route; exact selected international SKU photometry still needs checking.

sources.title: Panasonic Vietnam fan download library
observations: Official Vietnam manuals are listed for fan and ducted exhaust product families.

sources.title: Panasonic FV-15NS3 cabinet fan specification
observations: Indexed table includes 220/230/240V at 50Hz, airflow, static pressure, noise, current and power. Full PDF fetch failed.

sources.title: Panasonic Vietnam ERV/cabinet brochure
sources.published_revision: Brochure title 2024; not proof of current stock
observations: Indexed performance diagram indicates 220–240V 50Hz pressure/flow curves; full PDF fetch failed.

sources.title: ODELIC download instructions
observations: IES, CAD, catalogue, specification and instruction files are listed; not every product has every file.

sources.title: ODELIC domestic downlight catalogue example
observations: Domestic downlight examples specify 100V; this does not describe all ODELIC products.

sources.title: ODELIC warranty and service
observations: Out-of-Japan use is in the exclusions for free repair. Electrical performance parts are retained at least six years after production ends.

sources.title: TOA global network
observations: Manufacturer lists Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh sales offices and links toa-vn.com; manufacturing office is separate.

sources.title: TOA SR-H2L
observations: Passive 8-ohm line-array example with optional matching transformer; datasheet, CAD and EASE simulation-data links are present.

sources.title: Yamaha Vietnam VXL
observations: Slim columns, brackets and an optional high-impedance transformer are listed; weather-resistant variants differ.

sources.title: Yamaha speaker modelling data
observations: Manufacturer acoustic modelling downloads are available; obtain exact model/version before church simulation.

sources.title: Yamaha installed-audio 2026 announcement
sources.published_revision: Manufacturer release 2026-02-03; release schedule is not inventory confirmation
sources.location: Main specifications, DME and XMS; release schedule
observations: DME3/DME5 and XMS examples specify 100–240V 50/60Hz. XMS output choices include low-impedance and 70/100V speaker lines.

sources.title: Audio-Technica ES925C/XLR manual
observations: ES925C/XLR example uses 11–52V DC phantom power; exact base and connector variants must be distinguished.

sources.title: Audio-Technica SEA authorized resellers
observations: Vietnam entries include DLPRO, ProAVL Vietnam, IO Trading and Quang Minh; the listing alone does not confirm a particular installation-mic SKU.

sources.title: Audio-Technica Japan authorized sellers
observations: Manufacturer names its official Amazon store among Japan authorized channels; each listing seller still needs checking.

sources.title: KDK worldwide agents
observations: Manufacturer names Thanh Cong Trading and Marketing Company Limited as Vietnam agent.

sources.title: KDK Malaysia 2024/2025 catalogue
observations: Ducted/sirocco and industrial examples publish pressure/flow curves, noise and motor data. 40KAQA example is 220–240V 50Hz; other examples are 240V.

sources.title: KDK Malaysia 24CUBM
observations: Malaysia product page states 220–240V 50Hz; Vietnam version and duty point must be confirmed.

sources.title: Mitsubishi Electric Vietnam contact/distribution
sources.location: Product enquiries and Vietnam distribution network
observations: Corporate page links household and factory-automation distribution and local warranty service.

sources.title: Mitsubishi low-voltage circuit breakers
observations: Manufacturer lists MCCB, MCB, RCCB/RCBO and accessories. No particular church rating is selected.

sources.title: Mitsubishi Vietnam ventilation catalogue
sources.published_revision: Filename suggests 2020; no current product approval inferred
observations: Official Vietnam catalogue identifies a ventilation range; exact voltage, curve and noise data need current model documents.

sources.title: Nitto Kogyo enclosures
observations: Manufacturer offers general, weatherproof and stainless enclosures; these are empty enclosures, not approved church boards.

sources.title: Nitto Kogyo CN-U enclosure
observations: Indoor steel CN-U example lists IP66 and dimension/drawing tables; rating applies to that product condition.

sources.title: Nitto Kogyo overseas bases
observations: Regional group sites include Singapore board manufacture and Thailand enclosures; Vietnam-specific warranty is unverified.

sources.title: Terasaki global network
observations: Vietnam is assigned to TERASAKI CIRCUIT BREAKERS(S) PTE. LTD. in Singapore.

sources.title: Terasaki TemBreak PRO standard series
observations: Ratings provide poles, amperes and Icu/Ics at AC415V, including differing breaking capacities across frames.

sources.title: Terasaki TemBreak PRO international catalogue
observations: Manufacturer publishes IEC 60947-2 catalogue; exact voltage rating, trip curve and selectivity require selected device data.

sources.title: Fujikura Dia Cable 600V CV catalogue
observations: 600V CV single/multicore cable construction references JIS C 3605; tables use Japanese nominal conductor sections.

sources.title: Fujikura Dia Cable ampacity method
observations: Ampacity data separates installation, temperature and grouping assumptions; cannot transplant a single value into the church design.

sources.title: Fujikura Dia Cable official product scope
observations: Power, control/instrumentation, communications and disaster-prevention cable classes are listed.

sources.title: MISUMI Vietnam Nitto enclosure listing
observations: MISUMI Vietnam identifies NITTO KOGYO TE12-34R with 2D CAD and dimensions. Listing is channel evidence, not an accepted board design.

sources.title: MISUMI Vietnam website operator/CAD terms
observations: MISUMI VIETNAM CO., LTD. operates the Vietnam website; CAD data has separate use terms.

sources.title: MonotaRO Japan delivery terms
observations: Japan delivery only; forwarding companies and overseas forwarding services are excluded.
